title: one of the ways I track my hormones

segments.text: I'm not trying to get pregnant, but I test my female hormones every day. Here's why. This device is fantastic for knowing where you're at hormonally throughout your cycle. Am I ovulating? Am I producing enough estrogen? This allows me to know the answers. If my results are abnormal, that can point to bigger issues like thyroid problems, pituitary gland problems, maybe perimenopause. And I'm also [music] measuring my cortisol, and this gives us another window into the body. How my body is responding to stress, [music] recovery, even metabolism. Women experience these things every single day without understanding what's [music] going on underneath the hood. And I think that's in part because the

literature is missing, and this is not the norm. This is just one part of my experiment [music] to make the female body as legible as possible. This is not a requirement for you to do at home as well. So, if you're feeling overwhelmed, please [music] don't. This is kind of above and beyond. I'm measuring super extensively, and we're spending over $2 million so that we can find out what's happening in my body to give signal to the scientific community for around what we should measure more extensively. As we get results and learn, I'll be sharing with you. So, if you're interested, follow along.
